content.comment_body: Hello everyone, Is it possible to connect [product_name] W774-1 / W734-1 with [company_name] [product_name] devices? We have mobile equipment on which we want to connect [product_name] so it can send data to [product_name] W738-1. Thank you.
Hi [user_name], Welcome to the forum. From what I know, yes. [product_name] also works with standard switches.

Hi [user_name], Thank you for your response. This brings up another question. Is there a [product_name] controller that can connect wirelessly to [product_name] W738-1 without needing to install [product_name] W774-1 / W734-1 with my [product_name]? Thanks.
[product_name] itself does not have wireless capabilities. You would need an additional wireless device for this purpose.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are discussing options for wirelessly integrating [product_name] devices with [company_name] wireless products for mobile equipment. It is clarified that [product_name] modules lack built-in wireless features and will require extra hardware for wireless connectivity, which may complicate the system setup.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are looking for a [product_name] controller with integrated wireless features, or would prefer a simple wireless solution that does not require extra hardware.
